title: glyceria subfastigiata
intro: Glyceria subfastigiata, commonly known as Dwarf Mannagrass or Small Tufted Glyceria, is a perennial grass species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Glyceria subfastigiata include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues and soothe digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
